questions.prompt: You change a variable in a Figma library file. When do other files get it?

options.text: At once, as soon as you save
options.explanation: Figma says changes only appear in the current file until you publish them.
Right. Figma says changes stay in the current file until you publish them. Then others can accept them.
Figma says you can publish variables in a library, on paid plans.

questions.prompt: Which Claude Code setting stops edits to a path, whatever Claude decides?

options.explanation: CLAUDE.md is guidance. Chapter 3: a rule is not a lock.
Right. Anthropic says to add an Edit deny rule for paths no tool may change.

questions.prompt: Before you click Import tokens in Penpot, what does Penpot say to do?

options.text: Export your tokens as a backup
options.explanation: Right. Import replaces all tokens, sets and themes, so Penpot says to export first.
Import tokens works on a connected library. Penpot's advice is to export a backup.
Import already replaces them. Export them first if you want to keep them.
